purpose: Domestic-language and English address display profiles for all eight UN M49 Central America countries, with explicit postcode-transition, Address2, street, descriptive-direction and P.O. Box policies; not an address-existence, postal-assignment, geocoding or deliverability claim.

locality_registry.role: Seven GeoNames-derived locality layers plus Mexico's preserved official INEGI municipality-role snapshot. Counts are source rows rather than unique real-world places. The six direct-ID postal aliases are not an official postcode crosswalk, and no row proves a street, house number, postcode assignment, geocode or deliverable address.
